title: Washington State Legislature Page Program
who_text: Students at least 14 years old who have not turned 17, with parent or guardian permission and a teacher recommendation
description: Pages spend one week working at the state capitol in Olympia while lawmakers meet from January into spring. You are sponsored by a legislator and can page only once. Applications for the 2027 session open November 1, 2026.

title: Washington State Legislative Internship Program
who_text: College juniors and seniors in good academic standing who will receive academic credit for the internship
description: Interns work for the Washington State Legislature during the 2027 session, from January 5 to April 25, 2027. You earn a monthly stipend and college credit. The priority deadline is October 21, 2026.
